title: 600 diseases in 600k individuals: gene search
bodyHtml:
Begin typing a gene name, select a name from the list of matches, and click the Search button to see phenotypic associations for that gene.

The PheWAS plot displays associations for the gene across all 601 phenotypes, grouped by category. The dotted line indicates p-value = 2.5e-6. Upward-facing triangles denote positive direction of effect, while downward-facing triangles denote negative direction of effect. Mouse over a point to see the phenotype, p-value, and beta.

dataTableLegendHtml:
Filter the plot and table using the filters above:

  • Phenotype: type in a full or partial phenotype "meaning" and press "Return"
  • Category: select a phenotype category from the menu to see pehnotypes in that category
  • P-value: enter a value to set a lower threshold (examples: 5e-8, 0.001)

Click on a column header to filter the table by that column.

In the table, click the View button to see the gene-level association scores calculated using different variant masks.
